comments.author: @travellives
comments.text: If you grew up on St. Kitts or Nevis, what’s one detail about daily life on your island that you wish more visitors noticed? We’d love to hear from both sides of the channel.

comments.author: @orettacarter1312
comments.text: They need to build a bridge connecting the islands, which will be much easier.

replies.author: @travellives
replies.text: I think so too, perhaps they are planning to build a bridge to connect these two islands in the future.

comments.author: @NeuroTortureVictim
comments.text: They need to build a bridge to connect the two islands. Ferrying everything between two islands including cars is stressful and expensive.

replies.author: @travellives
replies.text: I think so too; they should build a bridge to make traveling and getting around more convenient.
